_about: The groupset seen in a checked ad's photos, read by eye, for ads whose text doesn't name it (see webapp/photo_groupset.py). Keyed like fetch_ad.ad_key. Same fields as an automatic read: brand, series, model_code, speeds, electronic, confidence (high/medium/low), evidence_en, evidence_nl, and optionally crankset (brand, series, model_code, confidence, photos, evidence_en, evidence_nl); without it the automatic read adds the crankset. An entry here wins over the automatic read, so it also corrects one.

marktplaats:m2459123766.evidence_en: Photo 5: rear derailleur printed RIVAL with the AXS battery on top; photo 4: SRAM front derailleur with battery and a Rival AXS crank with power meter.
marktplaats:m2459123766.evidence_nl: Foto 5: achterderailleur met RIVAL erop en de AXS-accu bovenop; foto 4: SRAM-voorderailleur met accu en een Rival AXS-crank met vermogensmeter.

marktplaats:m2455946444.evidence_en: Photo 4: rear derailleur printed Claris; photo 3: the Claris 2x8 crankset.
marktplaats:m2455946444.evidence_nl: Foto 4: achterderailleur met Claris erop; foto 3: het Claris 2x8-crankstel.

marktplaats:m2458830716.evidence_en: Photo 8: 12-speed 105 crank and a wireless Di2 front derailleur; photo 7: Di2 rear derailleur, no shift cables.
